x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Update set 1: CMDB_Foundation_<client>_v1 (global scope) - cmdb_identifier_entry changes for computer/hardware classes (priority order) - cmdb_reconciliation_definition records for the Tenable discovery source - CMDB Health configuration for in-scope classes (thresholds, duplicate detection) - Import set table + transform map for ownership backfill (coalesce serial_number) - Reports: CMDB completeness for in-scope classes Update set 2: VR_Foundation_<client>_v1 (Vulnerability Response scope) - sn_sec_cmn_ci_lookup_rule order / activation changes - sn_sec_cmn_src_cmdb_map adjustments - Reconcile Unmatched Discovered Items schedule - VR assignment rule configuration - Integration run failure notification - Report: open VITs by CI class and match-rate trend Note: store applications (VR, Tenable integration) do not travel in update sets — versions must match across environments.
